tree.heading: Reimbursement of expenses
tree.text: Members of the Board shall serve without pay, but may receive travel expenses, including per diem in lieu of subsistence, in accordance with sections 5702 and 5703 of title 5.

tree.heading: Conflict of interest
tree.text: The Librarian shall establish rules and procedures to address any potential conflict of interest between a member of the Board and responsibilities of the Board.

tree.heading: Meetings
tree.text: The Board shall meet at least once each fiscal year. Meetings shall be at the call of the Librarian.

tree.heading: Quorum
tree.text: Eleven members of the Board shall constitute a quorum for the transaction of business.
